name: Total-reflux H2-D2 cryogenic distillation (HETP of ICSI B5 ordered packing, 50 mm column) at 21-23 K and ~1 bar in a vacuum cold box with an LH2-fed condenser
plain_name: Separate heavy hydrogen from ordinary hydrogen by distilling the liquid at about 20 K, as done for tritium removal plants
description: Laboratory-scale detritiation/fusion fuel-cycle isotope-separation column at ICSI Rm. Valcea: 0.3 m3 vacuum cold box (1e-5 mbar), condenser cooled by LH2 from a Stirling PPH liquefier, electric boiler for reflux, H2-D2 mixtures at 0.9-1.2 bar sampled for GC.
keywords: Separate heavy hydrogen from ordinary hydrogen by distilling the liquid at about 20 K, as done for tritium removal plants

sources.citation: Lazar et al., Preliminary tests on a hydrogen isotope separation cryogenic facility, at the laboratory scale, within the Cryogenic Laboratory from ICSI Rm. Valcea, Progress of Cryogenics and Isotopes Separation 22(2) (2019) 5-12

reported_equipment: Agilent TwisTorr 304 FS turbo pumping system
ICSI B5 ordered packing column (50 mm)
